id./param/scenario/cs/b_100_cs_140.pack|cs_: ...It's over, evil dragon. Perish before the power of the magic mirror...!
"...I was finally able to return to my true form. Thanks to you. I thank you.
"The dragon's curse was strong, and the mirror's light didn't reach from outside. But...
"Because you weakened the dragon, the mirror's power inside its body took effect.
"But... why was the magic mirror in the dragon's body...
"...I was a dragon too long. My life will soon end.
"Tell my mother, Miko, the village is saved. And... may she be happy forever...
"...When I found the dragon here, I thought I'd never forgive Miko for deceiving everyone. But...
"Just as I didn't want Mum sacrificed... Miko wanted to protect her family too, didn't she?
"Miko and I are the same. We both did bad things, and we both love our families...
"...Let's go back to the village, brother. We must report. Tell them not to worry, the dragon won't appear again."
